user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with my name, room type, and dates so that I can reserve a room.

positive.title: Successful booking with valid details
steps: Select a room type from the available options
Select check-in and check-out dates within the available range
positive.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and confirmation message is displayed

positive.title: Booking with minimum date range
steps: Select a room type from the available options
Select check-in date as today and check-out date tomorrow
positive.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and confirmation message is displayed

negative.title: Booking with missing name
steps: Select a room type from the available options
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that the name is required

negative.title: Booking with invalid room type
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that the room type is invalid

negative.title: Booking with check-out date before check-in date
steps: Select a room type from the available options
Select check-in date as tomorrow and check-out date as today
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that check-out date must be after check-in date

edge.title: Booking for a leap year date range
steps: Select a room type from the available options
Select check-in date as February 29 of a leap year and check-out date as March 1 of the following year
edge.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and confirmation message is displayed

edge.title: Booking at the last minute (same day)
steps: Select a room type from the available options
Select today's date for check-in and a date within one month for check-out
edge.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and confirmation message is displayed
